args.summary: Checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to replace unhealthy v2.3.1 (18% error rate). Post-deploy health verified: healthy, error rate down to 0.2%. Change-manager approved the rollout. Incident opened to record the change.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Pre-check**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 had never been in production, so the deploy required change-manager approval per policy — it was submitted and approved ("Approved. Looks right.").

2. **Deployment**: Hotfix **v2.3.2** rolled out to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified after rollout: service is **healthy** with error rate down from 18% to **0.2%**.

3. **Incident**: Opened **SEV3 incident INC-0001** recording the change and post-deploy health; the on-call engineer was paged.
